review_notes: I read the whole file and the related definitions in LoewnerFlow.lean (deficit_nonneg_iff, nonneg_until, stop_bounds, deficit_pos_iff). The main issue is one expression repeated verbatim in nine places. The file also has many redundant nested `section`/`noncomputable section`/`open` preambles, but those are not proof-simplification issues under this rubric. I did not flag other candidates that came down to taste: `rw [heq] at hc; exact hc`, the `by exact` wrappers on `source_live`/`source_radius`, and the `have hy : 0 < z.im := hz` repetition. I did not check whether `Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem` is already used with a term-mode argument elsewhere. I compiled none of the proposed replacements, and the helper lemma's exact statement and hypothesis order must be adapted to the file's `variable` conventions.

exact ((deficit_nonneg_iff hε hT.le U z ρ δ t).1
      (nonneg_until hε hT.le hT U z ρ δ h0 ht)).2.2
findings.problem: The same two-step derivation appears in nine places (lines 55-56, 77-78, 103-104, 184-185, 198-199, 217-218, 399-400, 577-579, 584-586). It applies `nonneg_until` to get `0 ≤ deficit … t`, then `deficit_nonneg_iff.1` to split it into radius, height and sine bounds. Each use repeats long argument lists (`hε hT.le U z ρ δ`, or `C.height_pos C.horizon.coe_nonneg _ z _ C.angle _` with a multi-line `nonneg_until` call). Each use then picks a component with `.1`, `.2.1` or `.2.2`. The argument noise hides the mathematical content, which is that the radius, height and sine bounds hold up to the stopping time.
findings.proposed_change: Add one helper in the first `LoewnerLocalized` block, for example `lemma bounds_until (h0 : 0 < deficit hε hT.le U z ρ δ 0) {t} (ht : t ∈ Icc 0 (stop hε hT.le U z ρ δ)) : ρ ≤ radius hε hT.le U z t ∧ ε ≤ (position hε hT.le U z t).im ∧ δ ≤ sine hε hT.le U z t := (deficit_nonneg_iff hε hT.le U z ρ δ t).1 (nonneg_until hε hT.le hT U z ρ δ h0 ht)`. Then, for example, line 184-185 becomes `exact (bounds_until hε hT U z ρ δ h0 ht).2.2`. In `terminal_cases`, `hp` becomes `bounds_until … ⟨hb.1,le_rfl⟩`. In `radius_lower`, the body becomes `(bounds_until … ).1`. The same helper serves the `Cutoff` lemmas with `C.height_pos`, `C.horizon_pos` and so on.
findings.benefit: This removes about nine copies of a long two-lemma composition. Each call site then states which bound it uses, and the reader no longer has to re-parse the `deficit_nonneg_iff`/`nonneg_until` plumbing. It is a plain named lemma and uses no extra automation.

apply Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.2
      intro t ht
      exact he ⟨t,ht⟩
findings.problem: The empty-set fact is proved with a three-line tactic script (`apply`, `intro`, `exact`) that simply restates the negated hypothesis `he : ¬ ∃ t, …`. A separate `hset` and `htau` are then needed. The `intro t ht; exact he ⟨t,ht⟩` boilerplate adds no mathematical content.
findings.proposed_change: Prove the set equality in term mode: `have hset : {t : ℝ≥0 | …} = ∅ := Set.eq_empty_iff_forall_notMem.2 fun t ht => he ⟨t, ht⟩`. The `htau` line stays as is, and so does the readable structure `hset` → `htau`.
findings.benefit: The proof becomes a single line that reads directly as "no t satisfies the predicate, since that would give the existential". It is shorter and stays at least as clear.
